intro: With a deck in hand, you can enter your cards and save one reflection in this browser. Start with the question closest to yours.
openReading: Try the example with these cards

faq.q: How many cards are in a tarot deck?
faq.a: A standard deck has 78 cards: 22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana. The Fool is one of the 22.

faq.q: Can I teach myself to read tarot?
faq.a: Yes. Start with one card. Describe something you see, compare it with the card meaning and write one sentence in your own words.

faq.q: What do the four card suits symbolize?
faq.a: In this guide, Wands suggest action, Cups feelings, Swords thoughts or conflict, and Pentacles everyday resources. Other traditions differ.
Each of the four suits has a Page, Knight, Queen and King. Try reading one as a way to act before deciding it stands for a person.

faq.q: Is there a correct way to shuffle tarot?
faq.a: Use a method that feels comfortable and keeps the cards intact. For a large deck, move small packets from one hand to the other.

faq.q: Can I pull tarot cards online?
faq.a: Yes. Open the random draw and turn over a card. If you already drew a physical card, enter it in the reading workspace instead.

faq.q: How to do a daily tarot card reading?
faq.a: Draw one card and note a detail to watch for today. This evening, compare it with something that actually happened.

faq.q: What not to ask in a tarot reading?
faq.a: Avoid asking cards to diagnose an illness or reveal someone’s private thoughts. Try “What do I want to ask them?” instead.

faq.q: Do you have to read tarot cards in reverse?
faq.a: No. Decide before drawing. If you use reversals, try asking where the card’s theme feels blocked rather than assuming the opposite.

faq.q: Can tarot tell you how someone feels about you?
faq.a: A card cannot confirm another person’s feelings. Use it to name something you noticed and decide what to ask them directly.

faq.q: How do I know if a tarot card is a yes or no?
faq.a: There is no universal yes/no list. Use the card to name one condition that would make you lean toward or away from an option.

faq.q: Can tarot cards predict the future?
faq.a: A spread cannot establish what will happen. Use the future position to explore a possibility and an action you can take now.
